title: Ocean's Eleven
tagline: Eleven guys. Three casinos. One very long buffet.
about: Danny Ocean gathers a crew to rob three Las Vegas casinos in one night.
cue: Serve the prawn cocktail whenever Rusty is eating, which is most scenes.
faces: Terry Benedict's house. The house always wins

    StartersRusty's prawn cocktailPoached prawns on shredded iceberg with tomato horseradish sauce in martini glassesHow to make it500g green prawns1/2 iceberg lettuce125ml tomato sauce1 tbsp horseradish2 lemons1 dash Worcestershire saucePoach the prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel.Mix the tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce.Chill the prawns.Serve over shredded iceberg in martini glasses with lemon wedges.High roller chipsPaper thin fried potato chips, truffle salt and parmesan. Take a pinch.How to make it600g potatoes2 L vegetable oil1 tsp truffle salt30g parmesanSlice the potatoes paper thin on a mandoline, rinse and dry very well.Fry in the vegetable oil at 170°C in batches until golden.Toss straight away with truffle salt and finely grated parmesan so it sticks.Serve in a silver bowl.MainsBenedict's casino rib eye with béarnaiseDry brined rib eye with homemade béarnaise and wilted spinachHow to make it4 rib eye steaks60ml white wine vinegar1 bunch tarragon1 shallot3 egg yolks200g butter500g spinach200ml thickened cream600g frozen shoestring friesDry-brine the steaks overnight.Bake the fries at 220°C.Reduce the vinegar with tarragon and the chopped shallot to a spoonful.Whisk with the yolks over simmering water and drizzle in the warm melted butter.Wilt the spinach, squeeze and simmer in the cream.Sear the steaks, pull at 54°C and rest.Saul's matzo ball chicken soupChicken soup and matzo balls. Saul makes ten.How to make itAs written, serves 4Golden chicken broth simmered with onion, carrot and celery, with fluffy matzo balls, shredded chicken, fresh dill and cracked pepper.Simmer 1kg chicken thighs on the bone in 2L water with an onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks for 1 hour.Strain, shred the chicken and slice the carrots back in.Mix 120g matzo meal, 3 eggs, 3 tbsp melted chicken fat or oil, 3 tbsp broth and salt and chill 30 minutes.Roll into 12 balls and simmer in the broth, covered, for 30 minutes.Finish with dill.SweetsFountain show sundaeVanilla ice cream, hot fudge, piped whipped cream and gold sprinklesHow to make it100g dark chocolate300ml thickened cream1 L vanilla ice cream1 jar gold sprinklesMelt the chocolate with some of the cream for hot fudge.Whip the remaining cream.Scoop ice cream into four tall glasses and pour over the fudge.Pipe whipped cream high and scatter gold sprinkles so they catch the light.DrinksCasino martiniGin and a touch of dry vermouth stirred ice cold, with a green oliveHow to make it240ml gin40ml dry vermouth1 jar green olives1 bag iceStir the gin and vermouth over plenty of ice until very cold, one drink at a time.Strain into chilled martini glasses and add a green olive on a pick.
